authority: Repository owner authorized revised architecture and laboratory requirements for shared-laptop certification on 2026-10-25.
scope: Empirical local regression certification under the observed shared workstation context, including inherited execution-provider controls and background services.
tail_scope: Compare nearest-rank p95 over all 576 fixed observations in each lane, separately for each request/control marginal. Retain all nine block p95 ratios as diagnostics, without a per-block tail gate. The median and whole-process pair gates remain mandatory. No observation is discarded or replaced.
cli_channels: Guard request and control marginals independently, retain paired request/control ratios, and guard the complete process interval.
executor_trust: A reviewed local executor and native kernel APIs supply observations. Hashes establish byte identity; no hardware attestation is asserted.
rss_disposition: Retain raw process-lifetime peak RSS; do not substitute it for peak commit or claim protection from trimming.
observation: Retain exact commands, source and binary hashes, input bytes, process identities, all stdout/stderr, wall intervals, CPU samples, job observations and both members of every pair. Acquire exactly 64 latency slots or one measured memory compilation with no discarded or replacement attempts. Scheduling interference and product stalls remain measured. Failures consume their prospective slots; never silently retry or fill missing slots.
reference_build: Build the frozen reference kernel and candidate kernel independently using identical source-pinned measurement harness code. Bind both kernel source trees, harness source, build recipe and produced bytes explicitly; do not relabel a mixed-source build as one clean Git revision.
memory_scope: The memory worker is assigned while suspended to a private non-breakaway job with one active process allowed; require one total member, no limit terminations and natural quiescence. Kernel lifetime peak counters include native/Rust allocation, initialisation, parsing, warmup, all threads and teardown. Observer memory is outside this worker process. Native allocation success and semantic success remain mandatory.
claim_limits: No exclusive CPU, unlimited ancestor quota, idle host or absence of interference is asserted.
Paired comparisons reduce common context effects; they cannot prove every possible interference pattern cancels.

The median and whole-process rules tolerate at most two unfavorable pairs. The tail rule uses every fixed slot and grants no bad-block exclusion; it does not bound stalls below the pooled p95 rank. These are engineering acceptance rules, not claimed statistical confidence bounds.
Absolute wall times, tail latencies and RSS remain visible even when relative regression checks pass.
The historical isolated-host manifest, baseline and failures remain historical authority for that separate method; no result is relabeled as laboratory certification.
qualification: Require native positive and negative memory challenges, actual compiler reference/candidate execution, a deliberately slower candidate discrimination challenge, independent raw-evidence reconstruction, all governed workload coordinates and unchanged functional resource checks before profile adoption.
publication: Certification does not authorize publication. Source integrity, security, licensing, independent Release, signing and trusted verification remain required.
